blocks.text: Why SEO consultants need a better Chrome workflow on Mac

Your day involves constant switching between Google Search Console, Analytics, and various SEO tools. This context switching kills your flow. You spend hours on manual data entry and communication. Lazur acts as your voice-controlled assistant to bridge the gap between technical data and actionable tasks.
Practical Chrome tips for SEO consultants

items: Use ⌘ + T to open new tabs instantly for quick research queries.
Keep client-specific profiles separate using Chrome profiles. Create them in Settings > People > Add.
Pin important tabs like Search Console or your project tracker. Right-click the tab and select Pin.
Use ⌘ + L to jump to the address bar and type your search query immediately.
Clear site data for specific domains when testing new site changes. Go to Settings > Privacy and security > Site Settings.

blocks.text: How Lazur changes your SEO workflow

Lazur lives in the notch of your Mac. It sees your screen when you hold ⌥ ⌘. You can ask it to explain a complex search result or point at a specific setting in your SEO tool. It does not click buttons for you, but it guides you through every step.

Technical audits require deep focus. When you find an issue in a site audit, hold fn to dictate your findings directly into a document or ticket. You do not need to stop typing or move your hands from the keyboard. This keeps your focus on the technical details.
Using Lazur for research and reporting

Research is often a repetitive process of opening tabs and summarizing data. Ask Lazur to perform research tasks in the background. It uses its own extension to gather information. It comes back with a summary, saving you from manual browser work.
Common mistakes in SEO browser management

items: Keeping too many tabs open without using profiles. This slows down your Mac.
Ignoring browser cache issues when testing site changes. Clear site data regularly.
Relying on manual data entry for simple reports. Use dictation to speed up your notes.
Failing to organize your bookmarks by client project. Use folders to keep them tidy.
Not using shortcuts for common navigation tasks. Learn your keyboard shortcuts.

blocks.text: As an SEO consultant, you manage multiple clients. Each client needs their own set of extensions and bookmarks. Create a unique Chrome profile for every client. This prevents data cross-contamination and keeps your work environment clean. If you need help, ask Lazur to guide you through the process of creating a new profile.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons in Chrome for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons, edit files, or operate other apps for you. It points at things, guides you, and answers questions.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe for my client data?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only listens and looks at your screen while you hold the shortcut. Your data is not stored or used to train AI models.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur on older Macs?
